market_question: Will the Republicans win the Maine Senate race in 2026?
reasoning: Incumbent Senator Collins has filed for re-election. She has defied partisan trends before, winning in 2020 by 9 points even as Biden carried Maine. Her moderate brand and incumbency warrant a much higher probability than the market implies, despite the potential midterm penalty for a Trump administration.
evidence_points: Susan Collins won the 2020 Senate race with 51% of the vote, outperforming the GOP presidential ticket by over 10 points.
She has filed for re-election in 2026, securing an incumbent's advantage.
Maine elected a bipartisan slate of senators for decades; Collins's personal approval usually shields her from national headwinds.
sources_consulted: Maine Secretary of State election results 2020
Recent news indicating Collins filed for 2026 re-election
